movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Slapping the sides of the boots with hands.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group formations in streets or plazas.

signature_moves.description: Slapping the hand against the boot to create a percussive sound.
signature_moves.name: Boot Slap

signature_moves.description: Forceful contact with the ground to create a rhythmic beat.
signature_moves.name: Stomp

music_profile.sound_description: A percussive soundscape dominated by the rhythmic stamping of boots and the metallic rattling of bells or bottle caps, often accompanied by guitar-led township jive.
music_profile.vocal_style: Chanting in native languages like isiZulu, Sesotho, or isiXhosa.

basic_steps: Stamping the foot to create a percussive sound.
Slapping the hand against the side of the boot.
Coordinating rhythmic stomps with body articulation.
teaching.formation: Group formations, often in lines or circles.
